statements.notes: Solgar ABC Dophilus Powder is a selective blend of beneficial friendly bacteria specially formulated for the infant and child, including the well-known strains Bifidobacterium lactis BB-12 (BB-12) and Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG (LGG). Bifidobacteria and Lactobacilli species are present in the microflora of healthy children and infants and reside primarily in the large intestine. They support good health in these populations by helping to maintain a healthy balance within the intestine's microbial ecology.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement for infants and children, take one half (1/2) teaspoon (1.5 g) daily, or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.
Mix with infant formula, milk, juice or water or may be sprinkled on foods.
Free of: Gluten, wheat, dairy, soy, yeast, sugar, sodium, artificial flavor, sweetener, preservatives and color.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: If you are pregnant, nursing, taking any medications or have any medical condition, please consult your healthcare practitioner before taking any dietary supplement.
This product requires adult supervision and is not to be dispensed by children.
Discontinue use and consult your healthcare practitioner if any adverse reactions occur.
Store unopened container at room temperature. Refrigerate after opening.
Do not use if outer bottle seal is missing or damaged.
Keep out of reach of children.

BB-12 and TH-4 are registered trademarks of Chr. Hansen.
LGG is a registered trademark of Valio Ltd.
This product is sold by weight, not by volume; therefore settling may occur.
